title: HDR10 output pass applies exposure, tone map and PQ to an intermediate that holds sRGB-encoded BT.709 values
expected_finding: fsVisual writes the sRGB-encoded material colour into scene_intermediate; fsOutput's HDR branch treats it as linear radiance and PQ-encodes it for the A2B10G10R10 / HDR10_ST2084 swapchain without sRGB decode or BT.709 -> BT.2020 conversion (washed-out midtones)
